# AwesomeSwiftUI: every component with its source

Copy-paste SwiftUI components for iOS 18 through iOS 27. Swift 6, MIT.

## Aurora Mesh Background

An animated aurora background made with a mesh gradient.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/AuroraMeshBackground/AuroraMeshBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A slowly moving aurora built with a mesh gradient.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, it shows a still gradient.
struct AuroraMeshBackground: View {
    var first: Color = .indigo
    var second: Color = .purple
    var third: Color = .teal
    var speed: Double = 0.6

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { context in
            MeshGradient(
                width: AuroraMesh.size,
                height: AuroraMesh.size,
                points: AuroraMesh.points(at: reduceMotion ? 0 : context.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed),
                colors: [
                    first, second, first,
                    third, second, first,
                    second, first, third,
                ]
            )
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

enum AuroraMesh {
    static let size = 3

    /// Corners stay fixed and edge points slide along their edge, so the mesh always fills the view.
    static func points(at time: TimeInterval) -> [SIMD2<Float>] {
        func wave(speed: Double, phase: Double) -> Double {
            0.5 + sin(time * speed + phase) * 0.2
        }

        let positions: [(Double, Double)] = [
            (0, 0), (wave(speed: 0.8, phase: 2.1), 0), (1, 0),
            (0, wave(speed: 0.9, phase: 0)), (wave(speed: 1, phase: 0.7), wave(speed: 0.6, phase: 4.2)), (1, wave(speed: 0.7, phase: 1.3)),
            (0, 1), (wave(speed: 1.1, phase: 3.4), 1), (1, 1),
        ]
        return positions.map { SIMD2(Float($0.0), Float($0.1)) }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AuroraMeshBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            AuroraMeshBackground()

            Text("Aurora")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    AuroraMeshBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Pressable Button Style

A button style that shrinks and dims on press, then springs back.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/PressableButtonStyle/PressableButtonStyle.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Shrinks and dims a button while it is pressed, then springs back.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the button only dims.
struct PressableButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    var pressedScale: CGFloat = 0.94
    var pressedOpacity: Double = 0.8

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed && !reduceMotion ? pressedScale : 1)
            .opacity(configuration.isPressed ? pressedOpacity : 1)
            .animation(.spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.45), value: configuration.isPressed)
    }
}

extension ButtonStyle where Self == PressableButtonStyle {
    static var pressable: PressableButtonStyle { PressableButtonStyle() }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PressableButtonStyleDemo: View {
    @State private var likes = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            Text(likes == 1 ? "1 like" : "\(likes) likes")
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                .contentTransition(.numericText())

            Button {
                withAnimation { likes += 1 }
            } label: {
                Label("Like", systemImage: "heart.fill")
                    .font(.title2.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 44)
                    .padding(.vertical, 20)
                    .background(.pink.gradient, in: .capsule)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.pressable)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

#Preview {
    PressableButtonStyleDemo()
}
```

## Glass Action Menu

A floating Liquid Glass button whose actions morph out of it.

Category: Glass. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Glass/GlassActionMenu/GlassActionMenu.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassActionItem: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: String
    let systemImage: String
    let action: () -> Void
}

/// A floating Liquid Glass button whose actions morph out of it.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the actions appear without morphing.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassActionMenu: View {
    let items: [GlassActionItem]

    @State private var isExpanded = false
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title2) private var buttonSize = 58.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .bouncy(duration: 0.5, extraBounce: 0.05)
    }

    var body: some View {
        // Known issue: iOS 27.2 reports the toggle's accessibility frame as the whole
        // stack when expanded. iOS 26.5 reports it correctly.
        GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 18) {
            VStack(spacing: 14) {
                if isExpanded {
                    ForEach(items) { item in
                        glassButton(id: item.id, systemImage: item.systemImage, label: item.title) {
                            withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded = false }
                            item.action()
                        }
                    }
                }

                glassButton(
                    id: "toggle",
                    systemImage: "plus",
                    label: isExpanded ? "Close actions" : "Show actions",
                    rotation: isExpanded ? 45 : 0
                ) {
                    withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded.toggle() }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func glassButton(
        id: String,
        systemImage: String,
        label: String,
        rotation: Double = 0,
        action: @escaping () -> Void
    ) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(.title2.weight(.semibold))
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(rotation))
                .frame(width: buttonSize, height: buttonSize)
                .contentShape(.circle)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
        .glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .circle)
        .glassEffectID(id, in: namespace)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassActionMenuDemo: View {
    @State private var lastAction = "Tap the button"

    private var items: [GlassActionItem] {
        [
            GlassActionItem(id: "share", title: "Share", systemImage: "square.and.arrow.up") { lastAction = "Share" },
            GlassActionItem(id: "favorite", title: "Favorite", systemImage: "star") { lastAction = "Favorite" },
            GlassActionItem(id: "delete", title: "Delete", systemImage: "trash") { lastAction = "Delete" },
        ]
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .bottomTrailing) {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.orange, .pink, .indigo], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            Text(lastAction)
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)

            GlassActionMenu(items: items)
                .padding(24)
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)
#Preview {
    GlassActionMenuDemo()
}
```

## Reorderable Card List

A stack of cards you can drag into a new order, without using List.

Category: Lists. Minimum: iOS 27.0. Path: Components/Lists/ReorderableCardList/ReorderableCardList.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A stack of cards the user can drag into a new order, without using `List`.
@available(iOS 27, *)
struct ReorderableCardList<Item: Identifiable & Sendable, Card: View>: View where Item.ID: Sendable {
    @Binding var items: [Item]
    @ViewBuilder let card: (Item) -> Card

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                ForEach(items) { item in
                    card(item)
                }
                .reorderable()
            }
            .padding()
            .reorderContainer(for: Item.self) { difference in
                let destination: Item.ID? = switch difference.destination.position {
                case .before(let id): id
                case .end: nil
                }
                items = CardReordering.moving(difference.sources, before: destination, in: items)
            }
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 27, *)
enum CardReordering {
    /// Moves `sources` in front of `destination`, or to the end when it is nil.
    static func moving<Item: Identifiable>(
        _ sources: [Item.ID],
        before destination: Item.ID?,
        in items: [Item]
    ) -> [Item] {
        if let destination, sources.contains(destination) { return items }

        let moved = sources.compactMap { source in items.first { $0.id == source } }
        var remaining = items.filter { !sources.contains($0.id) }
        let index = remaining.firstIndex { $0.id == destination } ?? remaining.endIndex
        remaining.insert(contentsOf: moved, at: index)
        return remaining
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 27, *)
struct ReorderableCardListDemo: View {
    private struct Step: Identifiable, Sendable {
        let id: String
        let systemImage: String
        let color: Color
    }

    @State private var steps = [
        Step(id: "Design", systemImage: "paintbrush.fill", color: .pink),
        Step(id: "Build", systemImage: "hammer.fill", color: .orange),
        Step(id: "Test", systemImage: "checkmark.seal.fill", color: .green),
        Step(id: "Ship", systemImage: "paperplane.fill", color: .blue),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ReorderableCardList(items: $steps) { step in
            HStack(spacing: 16) {
                Image(systemName: step.systemImage)
                    .font(.title2)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .frame(width: 52, height: 52)
                    .background(step.color.gradient, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 14))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Text(step.id)
                    .font(.title3.bold())

                Spacer()

                Image(systemName: "line.3.horizontal")
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            .padding()
            .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20))
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 27, *)
#Preview {
    ReorderableCardListDemo()
}
```
